Hi Liam —

Great to meet you on the call this morning. As discussed, we need a short vendor master packet to create Stromline as an approved payee in our system so we can issue the first PO and kick off onboarding. To move quickly, can you please provide the following items by end of day Thursday: 

- Legal entity name (exact as appears on tax documents)
- Registered address and mailing address (if different)
- Tax ID / EIN or VAT number (depending on jurisdiction)
- Primary AP contact name, email, and phone for invoicing/remittance
- W-9 (or W-8BEN/W-8BEN-E if applicable) signed PDF
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account number) OR confirmation you will be paid via invoice/PO-only terms

I've attached our PO template for your reference (Redwood_PO_Template_v1.xlsx). Once we receive the packet and an approved W-9, I will create Stromline's payee record and route a test PO.

Portal note: I will send an invite to your AP contact to Redwood's vendor portal (where you can upload the signed W-9 and remittance files). If you prefer to return the documents via email, that's fine — but the portal is fastest for ongoing updates.

If any of the items above require internal approvals or you're missing anything, let me know and I can loop in procurement.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
